summary:
- TES exchangers foundations designed for Solana Generating Station
- Two reinforced concrete footings with dimensions and thickness specified

- Design based on geotechnical report and static finite elements analysis
- Soil classified as S1, chloride contents irrelevant due to water levels
- Document No: 4521-CAL-AEE-75-52-0001-GAR for TES Exchangers foundations project at Solana Generating Station.
- Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle allows for non-standard billing cycles upon request.
- Confidentiality notice restricts use and reproduction of information to authorized parties only.
- Test borings PB-09 and PB-11 are located where they project the foundation.
- Safety factors include ACI-318 for concrete and rolled steel, ANSI/AISC 360-05 (LRFD) for rolled steel.
